'''Stax Mullawny''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Mullawny served as a [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] for the [[Rogue Eight/Legends|eighth]] [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]] of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Group]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]], during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] when [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Troop/Legends|troops]] attacked the Rebels [[Echo Base/Legends|stationed]] [[Hoth/Legends|there]]. Mullawny was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the battle when Rogue Eight was shot down.

==Biography==
Stax Mullawny was a scarred [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Corellian/Legends|from]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Mullawny joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] the Alliance's headquarters were on the desolate [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] at [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]], as the Rebels tried to overthrow the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Mullawny was part of the base's [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] complement that composed [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Flight]], [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]], and [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Green Squadron]].<ref name="Warfare" />

[[File:Rogue_Group_TESB_Manga.jpg|250px|thumb|The twelve airspeeders of Rogue Group, including gunner Mullawny, attack during the Battle of Hoth.]]
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], an Imperial [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droid]] discovered the existence of the Rebel presence on Hoth, leading the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military's]] [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]] to [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|attack]] the Rebels there. Mullawny was one of the many Rebel pilots from the starfighter complement who were scrambled together to create Rogue Group. A [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] in the [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]] designated [[Rogue Eight/Legends|Rogue Eight]], Mullawny flew with pilot [[Vekozev Kabir|Zev Kabir]] as Rogue Group attempted to buy time for the Rebel personnel to evacuate Echo Base aboard [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transports]]. As Rogue Group confronted the Imperial forces, Rogue Eight was shot down and both Mullawny and Kabir were [[Death/Legends|killed]] in action.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Personality and traits==
Mullawny was a scarred, sardonic person.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Skills and abilities==
Stax Mullawny was a tinkerer who knew an immense amount about the weaker points of Imperial facilities and equipment.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
Stax Mullawny first indirectly appeared as a snowspeeder in the [[Star Wars Manga: The Empire Strikes Back 1|first issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Manga: The Empire Strikes Back]]'' series, illustrated by [[Toshiki Kudo]] and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="Empire Manga 1">[[Star Wars Manga: The Empire Strikes Back 1|''Star Wars Manga: The Empire Strikes Back'' 1]]</ref> on [[January 27]], [[1999]]<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54604/star_wars_the_empire_strikes_back_manga_1999_1|text=Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back Manga (1999) #1}}</ref> as an adaptation of<ref name="Empire Manga 1" /> the [[1980]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']].<ref name="ESB">{{Film|V}}</ref> Mullawny was first identified as the T-47's gunner in [[2012]]'s ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="Warfare" />
